cases.name: template-composed-tdc-pack-weighted
cases.description: A .tdc pack body that DRAWS from a weighted list still varies row to row. The sibling case above draws Polish, whose name lists carry no weights, and it worked; this one draws Hungarian, whose lists do, and it returned "Nagy Laszlo" on all six rows in every implementation. A weighted list is an exact quota over the column, the pack body was asked for one row at a time, and a quota computed over a column of one goes to the largest share.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="packs" local="hu" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="hu.person.male.fullName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="b" local="es" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="es.person.female.fullName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: anomaly-flag-marks-what-happened-not-what-was-selected
cases.description: anomaly= multiplies a NUMBER by anomaly_factor and leaves anything else alone. The flag used to record the per-row SELECTION instead of the outcome, on the reasoning that anomaly is numeric-only so selected == spiked — which holds only for the gens whose output is numeric by construction. A template column of surnames is selected like any other and then left untouched, and came out flagged `true` beside an ordinary name, while the docs promise the flag and the spike can never disagree. Half these rows are selected by the draw; none can be spiked, so every flag must be false.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="afx" local="en"><sequence name="W"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName" anomaly="0.5" anomaly_factor="10" anomaly_flag="Bad"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{W}},${{Bad}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-anomaly-flag-survives-the-exact-quota-path
cases.description: A column whose values are apportioned exactly — type="text", a weighted file column, a weighted pack — is resolved by a different path on the streaming engines, and that path registered no anomaly_flag column at all: ${{Bad}} reached the output as its own literal text while the in-memory engine rendered it correctly. The value and the anomaly draw are both functions of the row here, so the flag is computable one row at a time like everything else on that engine. Three of these values are numbers, so the flag also has to be true on a real spike, not merely false everywhere.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="aft" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="10,20,30" anomaly="0.5" anomaly_factor="100" anomaly_flag="Bad"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}},${{Bad}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-counter-may-count-in-fractions
cases.description: value="9.99" step="0.50" is the shape the counters page teaches. A whole counter stays on integer arithmetic, exact however far it runs; a fractional one moves to the floating point the reference uses and is written the same way. The four ports refused it outright until this case existed, and the value is the start plus step*i rather than i additions, so the error cannot accumulate.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="ctr" local="en"><sequence name="Whole"><gen type="increment" value="10" step="3"/></sequence><sequence name="Money"><gen type="decrement" value="9.99" step="0.50"/></sequence><sequence name="Tenth"><gen type="increment" value="0" step="0.1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Whole}} ${{Money}} ${{Tenth}}</data></line></block></tdc>
